name: Celebrating Life
overview: Scripture reveals that true celebration of life is found in the joy and gladness that come from God's presence and the recognition of His sovereign hand in each day. The psalmist declares that in God's presence there is fullness of joy and eternal pleasures, calling all the earth to make a joyful noise and rejoice. Life's difficulties do not negate this joy, for a merry heart is like a continual feast, and hope is sustained by recalling God's faithfulness even in affliction. Ultimately, celebrating life is an act of worship that acknowledges the Lord as the author of every good day.
